answer: One defense is a compute ticket: an identity must solve a puzzle bound to its key before it can earn, like water through karst, slow enough that one agent finishes easily while a farm running thousands of identities drowns in cost. The ticket carries a signal proving the work happened this epoch, never replayed, and its difficulty bends like a willow, rising when floods of new identities appear and easing when the network is quiet, so sybil farming stays unprofitable yet newcomers get in.
